title: UTCS Line Item
description: Line item within a Transaction Context. All monetary values are decimal strings to avoid floating-point precision issues.

line_number.description: Unique identifier within the transaction. MUST be unique across all lines.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item. Decimal permitted for measured goods. MUST be non-zero. A negative quantity is permitted only when document_type is return, and on that line amount MUST be negative as well. A positive quantity on a return is the count of units returned.

amount.description: Total monetary amount for this line as a decimal string (e.g., "49.99"). MUST NOT be a bare numeric type. On a return this is the signed tax base and MUST be negative. When quantity is negative, amount MUST be negative.

description.description: Human-readable description. Used for natural-language classification when tax_code is not provided.

tax_code.description: Tax code for the line. Accepts a standardized or provider-specific custom value. Input HINT only; the provider may override. If omitted, the provider may classify from item_code and description.

tax_included.description: If true, the amount includes tax. Default: false.

discounted.description: If true, the transaction-level discount is allocated to this line. Providers allocate the document discount only across lines flagged discounted. Default: false.

hs_code.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff code. REQUIRED when cross-border@1.0 capability is invoked.

revenue_account.description: GL account code. Some jurisdictions have account-based taxability rules.

entity_use_code.description: Per-line entity/use-based exemption reason, overriding the customer-level entity_use_code for this line. Asserts the line is exempt by buyer status or intended use rather than a certificate. Same controlled vocabulary as the result exemption_reason.

exemption_certificate_id.description: Per-line exemption certificate identifier, overriding the customer-level exemption_certificate_id for this line. Use when only specific lines are covered by a certificate. The provider MUST apply it or reject the request with UTCS-5001, UTCS-5002, UTCS-5003, or UTCS-5004. It MUST NOT be ignored. A prior successful exemption validation does not apply it.

addresses.description: Per-line address override for split-origin or drop-ship fulfillment. When present, these override the transaction-level addresses for this line only.

ship_from.description: Line-level origin address. Overrides the transaction ship_from for this line.

ship_to.description: Line-level destination address. Overrides the transaction ship_to for this line.

tax_override.description: Per-line override of the tax calculation for this line only (overrides any transaction-level tax_override for this line). Used for line-specific tax-date, forced tax amount, or exemption scenarios such as imported amounts and accruals.

value.description: Override value. For tax_date: ISO 8601 date. For tax_amount: decimal string. For exemption: exemption reason code.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the override. Required for audit trail.

parameters.description: Per-line key-value pairs for provider-specific or capability-specific metadata (e.g., exemption codes, marketplace liability indicators, product category hints).
